tahajjud.summary: night namaz offered içinde  last third   night, before Ertir.
tahajjud.why: Allah descends   lowest heaven içinde  last third   night ve asks who will call upon Him.  Prophet ﷺ regularly prayed at night even when istege bagly için him.
tahajjud.benefits: Draws one closer  Allah, softens  heart, ve was  habit   righteous before him.  time when dua dir especially answered.

fajr.summary: dawn namaz —  first   five daily farz prayers.
fajr.why: Allah commanded establishing namaz at  edges   gün; Ertir marks  start   Muslim gün ve was never abandoned by  Prophet ﷺ içinde congregation veya alone.
fajr.benefits: Whoever prays Ertir dir under Allah's protection. It dir witnessed by  angels   night ve gün ve brings açyk için  rest   gün.

sunrise.summary: moment  sun rises above  horizon —  time marker, not  namaz itself.
sunrise.why: Namaz dir forbidden while  sun dir rising (ve at zenith ve setting) so  ummah does not resemble sun-worshippers. Knowing sunrise helps time Ishraq ve avoid invalid namaz vakitler.
sunrise.benefits: Observing Allah's signs içinde  sky increases awe (taqwa) ve helps structure  morning sunnah prayers correctly.

ishraq.summary: two-rak'ah sunnah namaz after  sun has fully risen (about 15–20 minutes after sunrise).
ishraq.why: The Prophet ﷺ said whoever prays Fajr in congregation then sits remembering Allah until sunrise, then prays two rak'ahs, receives the reward of a complete Hajj and 'Umrah.
ishraq.benefits: Immense reward ile minimal effort when combined ile Ertir içinde congregation.  peaceful start   gün içinde zikir ve istege bagly namaz.

duha.summary: forenoon namaz — typically two  eight rak'ahs between sunrise ve Öýle.
duha.why: Charity is due on every joint of the body each day; even a few rak'ahs of Duha fulfills that charity for the limbs through worship.
duha.benefits: Forgives sins, brings sustenance (rizq), ve revives  neglected sunnah. Flexible timing makes it accessible when  gün allows.

dhuhr.summary: midday namaz —  second farz namaz, when  sun passes its zenith.
dhuhr.why: five daily prayers were made farz   Night Yolculuk; Öýle breaks  day's busyness ile remembrance  Allah.
dhuhr.benefits: Prophet ﷺ said  first deed judged   Gün  Resurrection dir namaz. Guarding Öýle protects  rest  one's deeds.

asr.summary: afternoon namaz —  middle namaz emphasized içinde  Guran.
asr.why: Allah specifically warns about guarding  middle namaz (Salat al-Wusta). It falls when many dir busy veya tired, so preserving it dir  sign  sincerity.
asr.benefits: Whoever misses Ikindi, it dir as if he lost his family ve wealth — highlighting its weight. Keeping it strengthens discipline through  gün.

maghrib.summary: sunset namaz — prayed immediately after  sun has ayarla.
maghrib.why: time opens right at sunset; delaying without reason risks missing  preferred window.  Prophet ﷺ warned against neglecting namaz until  sun has ayarla.
maghrib.benefits: Marks gratitude at  day's end ve was among  first prayers  Prophet ﷺ emphasized  his companions.

isha.summary: night namaz —  last   five farz prayers, after twilight fades.
isha.why: Completes  cycle  daily ibadet.  Prophet ﷺ said if someone prayed Ýatsy içinde congregation, it dir as if he prayed half  night.
isha.benefits: Brings tranquility before sleep ve completes  day's fard prayers. Often followed by Vitir, which dir sunnah mu'akkadah.

witr.summary: odd-numbered namaz (usually one veya three rak'ahs) after Ýatsy before Ertir — sunnah mu'akkadah, not one   five fard prayers.
witr.why: Prophet ﷺ said Allah dir Vitir (One) ve loves Vitir, so maintain  Vitir namaz. He never abandoned it, even when traveling.
witr.benefits: distinctive mark   believer's night routine. Closing  gün ile odd-numbered namaz aligns ile Allah's isimler ve  Prophet's istikrarly pratik.

tahiyyatul_masjid.summary: Two rak'ahs greeting  masjid when entering, before sitting.
tahiyyatul_masjid.why: When one  siz enters  masjid, let him pray two rak'ahs before sitting —  direct instruction   Prophet ﷺ.
tahiyyatul_masjid.benefits: Honors  house  Allah, prepares  heart için congregation veya private ibadet, ve replaces idle sitting ile immediate good.

hajat_istikhara.summary: Istege bagly prayers için personal needs (Salat al-Hajah) ve seeking Allah's guidance (Salat al-Istikhara).

travel.title: Seyahat ve namaz
travel.subtitle: Qasr, Jam', ve what  Guran ve Sünnet teach about salah   yolculuk
travel.takeaway: Allah legislated shortening (Qasr) ve combining (Jam') out  mercy için  traveller — not  abandon namaz, but  ease its performance   road.
travel.obligationsTitle: What siz dir still responsible için
travel.rakatsNote: Only  fard dir shown. Sünnet rawatib ve Vitir dir discussed below — they remain recommended, though many travellers lighten them için hardship.

quran.excerpt: When siz travel through  land, there is no blame on siz if siz shorten  prayer, if siz fear şol those who disbelieve may harm siz. Indeed,  disbelievers are ever  Arassala enemy - siz.

hadith.excerpt: Anas said: We travelled bilen  Messenger -iň Allah ﷺ.  mu'adhin called üçiçinde prayer we he said: 'Pray two rakahs' — we he did  same üçiçinde  other prayers except Agşam (three) we Fejr (two).
Ibn Abbas said:  Prophet ﷺ combined Öýle we Asr, we Agşam we Ýatsy içinde Madinah without fear ý-da rain. When asked why, he said: 'He wanted däl - burden his Ummah.'

Ya'la ibn Umayyah said: I said - Umar ibn al-Khattab: 'There is no sin if one shortens  prayer while travelling.' Umar replied: 'I wondered  same, so I asked  Prophet ﷺ we he said: It is charity -dan Allah — accept His charity.'
Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah loves şol His concessions be taken, just as He hates - be disobeyed.'

obligations: five daily prayers remain obligatory — shortened (Qasr) when siz qualify as  traveller.
Fejr (two rakahs) we Agşam (three rakahs) are never shortened.
siz may combine Öýle bilen Asr, we Agşam bilen Ýatsy, when  conditions -iň travel Ulgamak.
Each shortened prayer is prayed like  first two rakahs -iň  full prayer — recite Al-Fatiha we  surah, bow, prostrate, then sit üçiçinde tashahhud we salam.
When siz return Baş sahypa ý-da intend - settle, resume praying each prayer içinde full at its proper time.
Missed prayers while travelling must still be made up (Gaza) — travel does däl waive what was omitted.

qasr.title: Kasr — kysaltma
qasr.body: four-rakah fard prayers — Öýle, Ikindi, ve Ýatsy — dir prayed as two rakahs   uygun yolculuk. Pray them exactly as  first two rakahs at ana sayfa: standing recitation, one ruku, two sujud, tashahhud, ve salam. Ertir stays two rakahs ve Agşam stays three; neither dir shortened. Qasr applies   fard only.

jam.title: Cem' — birleştirme
jam.body: traveller may combine Öýle ile Ikindi into one sitting, ve Agşam ile Ýatsy into one sitting — praying both fard prayers geri--geri ile one ezan ve iqamah. Ertir cannot be combined ile any other namaz. Combining dir  separate concession den shortening: siz may shorten without combining, combine without shortening (içinde some situations), veya do both together.

jamTypes.title: Takdim & Te'hir Cem'i
jamTypes.body: Jam' al-Taqdim (early combining): pray both prayers together at  earlier prayer's time — e.g. Öýle ve Ikindi at Öýle time. Jam' al-Ta'khir (gecikti combining): pray both at  later prayer's time — e.g. Öýle ve Ikindi at Ikindi time.  Prophet ﷺ combined at Gözlegfah (Öýle at Ikindi time) ve at Muzdalifah (Agşam at Ýatsy time), establishing both forms.

when.title: Rugsatlar haçan başlaýar we gutarýar
when.body: Concessions begin once siz leave sizin town veya city   yolculuk — not için daily commutes within sizin locality. They end when siz return ana sayfa, veya when siz intend  stay at sizin destination için  period alimler define as 'settling' ( number  gün differs between schools). If siz dir unsure whether siz still say as  traveller, ask  alim before assuming  concessions.

distance.title: Seyahat distance
distance.body: Most alimler require  minimum seyahat distance before Qasr ve Jam' uygula — commonly cited as roughly 80 km (48 miles), veya about two days' yolculuk  foot. Some schools measure den  last buildings  one's city; others use  shorter threshold.  app does not calculate bu için siz — know sizin school's criterion ve uygula it ile  scholar's guidance.

sunnah.title: Sünnet prayers while travelling
sunnah.body: emphasized sunnah prayers (rawatib) before ve after fard remain virtuous but dir not gerekli. Many alimler permit leaving them while travelling due  hardship, especially when combining prayers.  greeting   masjid (tahiyyatul masjid) ve other voluntary prayers remain permissible whenever siz have time ve energy.

witr.title: Vitir   yolculuk
witr.body: Vitir dir sunnah mu'akkadah (strongly emphasized) ve should not be abandoned while travelling. Pray it after Ýatsy — even if siz combined Agşam ve Ýatsy — as one, three, veya more odd rakahs according  what siz can yönet. If siz fear sleeping before Ýatsy while travelling,  Prophet ﷺ permitted praying Vitir earlier after  combined Agşam-Ýatsy.

travel.disclaimer: Bu dir egitim içerik, not  personal fatwa. Distance thresholds, stay duration, combining rules, ve whether Jam' dir limited  need vary between  four schools — consult  qualified alim için sizin yolculuk.

duration.title: Duration  hayyz
duration.body:
Hayyz dir  regular monthly bleeding most women experience at  familiar time each cycle. Alimler discuss  minimum duration (some say one gün ve night, others require more) ve  maximum duration — commonly cited figures range den about 10  15 gün depending   school  thought.

Practically, note sizin usual pattern (‘ada): how many gün hayyz typically lasts ve when it usually begins. If bleeding continues beyond  maximum hayyz duration içinde sizin school,  extra gün may be treated as istihada —  rules  namaz ve oruç change once hayyz ends, even if bleeding continues.

istihada.title: Ystihaze — düzensiz kanama
istihada.body:
Istihada dir bleeding outside  normal hayyz period — between cycles, after puberty before  first regular period, veya when bleeding continues past  maximum hayyz duration.

Unlike hayyz, istihada does not lift  obligation  pray ve oruç.  woman ile istihada generally performs abdest için each namaz while bleeding dir aktif;  bleeding itself does not invalidate abdest according  many alimler.

Distinguishing hayyz den istihada can be difficult. Women ile  known cycle often rely  their habit,  time   month, ve  characteristics   blood. If siz dir unsure whether bleeding dir hayyz veya istihada, pause farz tracking only when siz dir confident it dir hayyz, ve consult  qualified alim için sizin specific case.

nifas.title: Nifas — logusalyk kanamasy
nifas.body:
Nifas is bleeding after childbirth. The same broad rules as hayd apply: salah and fasting are not performed during nifas, and missed Ramadan fasts are made up afterward — not the prayers.

Maximum duration differs by school; 40 days is commonly mentioned. When nifas ends, perform ghusl and resume all worship. Nifas and hayd are separate categories — a woman may experience both at different times in her life.

purity.title: Gan akmasy gutaranda — ghusl we dowam
purity.body:
When hayd or nifas ends, perform a full ghusl before resuming salah. Resume fasting only after hayd ends; any Ramadan fasts missed during hayd must be made up on other days.

Salah missed during hayd is not made up — Allah lifted that obligation. This is different from illness or travel, where missed prayers may need qaza. After ghusl, resume your normal worship and obligatory tracking in the app.

hayd.disclaimer: Bu dir egitim guidance, not  personal ruling.  details above vary between schools — consult  qualified female alim if sizin situation dir unclear.

sick.title: Hastalyk & namaz
sick.subtitle: Concessions için sickness ve what remains upon siz
sick.obligationsTitle: What siz dir still responsible için

hadith.excerpt: Prophet ﷺ said: 'Pray standing; if siz cannot, then sitting; if siz cannot, then on siziň side.'
Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah has removed -dan my Ummah mistakes, forgetfulness, we what they are forced - do.'
Imran ibn Husayn had  painful condition we prayed sitting.  Prophet ﷺ asked him: 'Can siz stand?' He said no, so  Prophet ﷺ said: 'Then pray sitting; if siz cannot, then lying on siziň side.'

obligations: If siz are able, pray içinde whatever position siz can — standing, sitting, ý-da lying down.
Reduce ý-da omit bowing we prostration only when siz genuinely cannot perform them.
If siz are too ill - pray at Hemmesi, şol prayer is waived — make it up (Gaza) when siz recover.
Missed Ramazan fasts due - illness should be made up when siz are able.
siz may still make Zikr, Dua, read Guran, we give charity.

positions.title: Hastayken namaz — pozisyonlar
positions.body:
varsayylan dir  pray standing ile full ruku ve sujud. If standing causes severe pain, weakness, veya harm, pray sitting — many alimler permit sitting even without standing first when hastalyk makes standing genuinely difficult.

If siz cannot sit upright, pray lying  sizin side veya geri, gesturing için ruku ve sujud ile sizin head. Use every position concession before skipping  namaz entirely.

If siz cannot use water için abdest because  hastalyk veya risk  harm, perform tayammum when its conditions dir met.

rukuSujud.title: Ruku & sujud ile limited movement
rukuSujud.body:
When siz cannot perform full bowing, incline sizin head için ruku —  deeper incline için sujud. Bu dir  concession used when praying sitting veya lying down.

If siz cannot move sizin head at tüm, alimler differ   minimum movement gerekli — some allow intention alone içinde extreme cases, while others require whatever movement dir physically possible.

Do not omit  entire namaz if siz can pray ile reduced movements.  Prophet ﷺ taught us  use concessions step by step rather than abandoning salah.

unable.title: Complete inability to pray
unable.body:
If you lose consciousness, fall into deep sleep through a prayer time, or are so severely ill that you cannot pray even with all position concessions — and the entire time for that prayer passes — that prayer is waived with no sin, but must be made up (qaza) when you recover.

Marking a day as excused (illness) in this app pauses obligatory tracking and holds your streak — it does not replace the obligation to make up missed prayers later.

For chronic or long-term illness, learn the fixed concessions that apply to your situation from a qualified scholar rather than assuming every day is fully waived.

fastingQaza.title: Oruç, recovery & make-up (kaza)
fastingQaza.body:
If fasting in Ramadan would worsen your illness or delay recovery, break the fast and make it up on other days after you recover — the Qur'an explicitly permits this for the ill.

Each missed Ramadan fast is made up with one day of fasting later; there is no kaffarah (expiation) unless the fast was broken without a valid excuse.

Missed salah during illness must also be made up in order once you are able — unlike hayd, where missed prayers are not qaza. When you recover, resume normal tracking and work through your qaza at a sustainable pace.

basics.title: What dir zekat?
basics.body:
Zekat dir  third rükün  Islam, sitting between  namaz (salah) ve  oruç  Ramazan. Içinde  Guran  command  establish namaz ve give zekat dir repeated many vakitler as  single pairing — showing şu ibadet  Allah ve care için His creation dir woven together. It dir not  istege bagly gift but  fixed, compulsory right şu  poor hold over  wealth   rich.

 word zekat means both temizlik ve growth. Giving  small, fixed portion  sizin surplus purifies  rest  sizin wealth ve sizin heart den greed, ve — by Allah's promise — causes what remains  grow içinde blessing rather than shrink.

 standard rate  monetary wealth dir one-fortieth, şu dir 2.5%. So için every 1,000  uygun wealth şu has completed its kameri year above  threshold, 25 dir due. Bu dir  modest paylaş by design: enough  circulate resources  those içinde need without straining  giver.

Zekat dir not  same as sadaqah. Sadaqah dir any voluntary charity, given içinde any amount, at any time,  almost anyone. Zekat dir  defined obligation —  ayarla rate,  ayarla categories  wealth, once ayarla conditions dir met, paid  ayarla categories  people. Neglecting it deliberately dir  serious sin; both  Guran ve Sünnet warn sternly against hoarding wealth while withholding its due.

purpose.title: Why zekat — purpose & wisdom
purpose.summary: It purifies wealth ve  soul, ve lifts  poor
purpose.body:
Allah says of zakat: "Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them to grow" (Qur'an 9:103). The obligation works on two levels at once — it purifies the giver's soul from stinginess and love of the world, and it purifies the wealth itself so that what stays in your hand is wholesome and blessed.

Socially, zakat is a divinely ordered system of circulation. When the Prophet ﷺ sent Mu'adh to Yemen he instructed that zakat be taken from their rich and given to their poor. Wealth is not meant to pile up among a few; zakat pulls it back into motion so the needy are fed, debtors are freed, and the community's bonds are strengthened.

Spiritually, giving zakat is an act of gratitude and trust. It answers the human urge to hoard with the certainty that provision comes from Allah, and it trains the believer to love giving. The one who pays zakat willingly finds their wealth protected, their heart lightened, and their reward stored with their Lord — "there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve" (Qur'an 2:277).

hawl.title: kameri year (hawl)
hawl.summary: Wealth must stay above nisab için one Hicri year
hawl.body:
Zakat on cash, gold, silver, and trade wealth is generally due only after that wealth has remained at or above the nisab threshold for one complete Hijri (lunar) year, known as the hawl. The Prophet ﷺ taught that there is no zakat on wealth until a year has passed over it.

In practice, note the date your zakatable wealth first reached nisab. That date becomes your annual zakat anniversary — each year, on that same Hijri date, you value everything you own and pay 2.5% of the total.

You do not need to track each coin separately. Most scholars hold that as long as your total stays at or above nisab across the year, small dips and rises in between do not matter — you simply assess the whole sum on your anniversary. If your wealth falls entirely below nisab during the year, many scholars consider the hawl to reset, restarting only when you next reach nisab.

Remember that the Hijri (lunar) year is about eleven days shorter than the solar year. If you prefer to pay on a fixed Gregorian date for convenience, some scholars permit it provided you slightly increase the rate to account for the shorter lunar cycle. Agricultural produce and livestock follow their own timing rules and are not tied to the hawl in the same way.

nisab.title: Nisab —  minimum threshold
nisab.summary: Measured against ~87.5 g gold veya ~595–612 g silver
nisab.body:
Nisab dir  minimum amount  wealth  person must own before zekat becomes farz. Someone whose net wealth stays below nisab tüm year owes no zekat —  obligation dir only  those who have  genuine surplus.

 Prophet ﷺ fixed  thresholds içinde  currency  his time: 20 dinars  gold veya 200 dirhams  silver. Içinde weight bu works out  roughly 85–87.5 g  gold, ve roughly 595–612 g  silver ( small variation reflects different scholarly conversions   dirham). Bu hesaplayycy uses widely cited figures  about 87.48 g gold ve 612.36 g silver.

Because gold ve silver no longer trade at  ratio they did içinde  Prophet's era,  two thresholds now give very different monetary values —  silver nisab dir far lower. Many contemporary alimler therefore advise measuring cash ve mixed wealth against  silver nisab: it makes more people liable, but şu means more   poor dir helped, which dir  spirit   obligation. Others follow  gold nisab. Both positions dir respected — follow sizin own scholar's guidance.

zakatable.title: What dir generally zakatable
zakatable.summary: Nakit, metaller, yatyrymlar, ticaret mallary, alacaklar
zakatable.body:
Zekat dir due  wealth şu has  potential  grow — money ve things held as money — rather than  items siz simply use.  main categories agreed upon across  schools dir cash, gold ve silver, trade goods, ve (ile their own rules) crops ve livestock.

Commonly zakatable bugün: cash içinde hand ve içinde bank accounts; gold ve silver, including bullion, coins, ve stored jewellery not içinde regular use; stocks, shares, ve mutual funds valued at their current market price;  merchandise ve inventory   business (trade goods), valued at resale price; strong receivables — loans ve invoices siz reasonably expect  collect; ve rental veya business income siz have kaydedildi rather than spent.

Many alimler also include accessible retirement savings ve cryptocurrencies held as  asset, treating them like cash veya investments. When içinde doubt,  guiding question dir simple: dir bu wealth  store  value veya  means  growth şu I could liquidate? If so, it dir likely zakatable. Value everything at today's market price  sizin zekat date — not at what siz originally paid.

exempt.title: What dir usually not zakatable
exempt.summary: Personal use items, worn jewellery, kilitli pensions
exempt.body:
Wealth tied up içinde sizin ordinary daily life dir generally not zakatable, because zekat hedefler growing wealth, not  things siz live ile ve use. Sizin ana sayfa, sizin car, sizin clothing, furniture, appliances, ve  tools ve equipment  sizin trade dir tüm exempt — however valuable they dir.

Gold ve silver jewellery şu  woman wears regularly dir  well-known point  difference.  Hanafi school holds şu tüm gold ve silver dir zakatable even if worn;  majority — Maliki, Shafi'i, ve Hanbali — exempt jewellery kept için normal personal use but include it if it dir hoarded as  store  wealth veya exceeds customary adornment. Follow  ruling   school siz follow.

Pension veya provident funds siz cannot yet access dir often excluded until  money actually comes into sizin hands, though some alimler require zekat   accessible portion. Debts owed  siz şu dir unlikely ever  be repaid dir usually not counted until recovered. As always,  finer details vary between schools — when  case dir unclear, ask  qualified alim rather than guess.

debts.title: Borçlar & kesintiler
debts.summary: Immediate debts may be deducted önce calculating 2.5%
debts.body:
Zakat is calculated on your net zakatable wealth, so genuine debts you owe can reduce the amount on which you pay. The clearest case is debts due now — an unpaid personal loan, an outstanding credit-card balance, rent or bills already owed. Most scholars allow these to be subtracted from your gross wealth before you apply the 2.5%.

Long-term debts such as a mortgage or a multi-year instalment plan are handled with more care, because deducting the entire balance would wipe out the zakat of almost anyone with a home loan. A common contemporary approach is to deduct only the payments due within the coming year, not the whole outstanding sum. Schools and scholars differ here, so pick a consistent method under guidance.

Two cautions. First, do not treat future or hypothetical expenses as deductible debts — only what you actually owe counts. Second, do not subtract last year's unpaid zakat as if it were an ordinary debt; unpaid zakat remains a due obligation and should simply be paid. When your debt situation is complex, a scholar's ruling is worth more than a rough guess.

recipients.title: Who may receive zekat
recipients.body:
Zakat may only be given to the categories of people Allah Himself named in Surah at-Tawbah (9:60). This is one of the few acts of worship where the recipients are fixed by revelation, not left to the giver's preference. The eight categories are: the poor (al-fuqara); the needy (al-masakin); those employed to collect and administer zakat; those whose hearts are to be reconciled (al-mu'allafah); the freeing of captives and those in bondage (fi'r-riqab); the debt-burdened (al-gharimin); in the cause of Allah (fi sabil Allah); and the stranded traveller (ibn as-sabil).

It is not required to give to all eight; giving your zakat to even one eligible category fulfils the obligation, and directing it to the poor and needy is the most common practice.

Equally important is who may not receive it. Zakat cannot be given to the wealthy, nor to those you are already obliged to support — your parents, your children, or your spouse — since supporting them is a duty you owe anyway. In the classical view it is a personal transfer of ownership to an eligible individual, not a general donation; scholars differ on whether institutions such as masjids or broad public projects qualify under the cause of Allah. It also cannot be given to the family of the Prophet ﷺ, the Banu Hashim, as zakat. Aim it deliberately at people who match the Qur'anic categories.

otherRates.title: Other types  zekat & zekat al-fitr
otherRates.summary: Crops, livestock, ve  pre-Eid zekat al-fitr differ
otherRates.body:
2.5% rate applies  money ve trade wealth — zekat al-mal, which bu hesaplayycy covers. Several other categories have entirely different rules ve rates.

Crops ve fruit have zekat due at harvest, not after  year:  rate dir 10% (ushr) için land watered naturally by rain veya springs, ve 5% için land irrigated by artificial effort veya cost. Grazing livestock — camels, cattle, sheep, ve goats şu graze freely için most   year — have their own species-by-species nisab counts ve sliding scales, drawn directly den  Sünnet.

Zekat al-fitr dir different again, ve every Muslim should know it. It dir  small, fixed charity — about one sa' (roughly 2.5–3 kg)   staple food such as dates, barley, wheat, veya rice, veya its cash value içinde many rulings — due at  end  Ramazan  behalf  every member   household, young ve old. Its purpose dir  purify  oruç person den any shortfall ve  ensure  poor also have food  celebrate Eid.  Prophet ﷺ commanded şu it be paid before  Eid al-Fitr namaz; paid afterwards it counts only as ordinary charity. Each  these categories has its own detailed rulings — seek guidance specific   asset.

mistakes.title: Common mistakes  avoid
mistakes.summary: Errors şu make zekat invalid veya miscalculated
mistakes.body:
Even sincere Muslims often slip on the practical details of zakat. Knowing the common errors helps you pay correctly and with peace of mind.

Forgetting the hawl or the anniversary: paying at a random time, or skipping years, leaves an outstanding obligation. Fix one Hijri date each year and assess your wealth on it.

Miscounting wealth: valuing gold or shares at their purchase price instead of today's market value, forgetting cash held in multiple accounts or currencies, or overlooking business inventory and money owed to you. Zakat is on everything zakatable that you own on your date.

Giving to the wrong people: handing zakat to parents, children, or a spouse you already support, or treating it as a generic donation to any good cause. It must reach one of the eight Qur'anic categories.

Intention errors: giving generously all year but never intending any of it as zakat. Zakat is an act of worship and needs the intention (niyyah) that this particular payment is your obligatory zakat.

Over-deducting debts: subtracting a whole long-term mortgage, or future expenses that are not yet owed, to shrink the bill. Only real, current liabilities reduce your zakatable wealth. When any of these is unclear for your situation, ask a qualified scholar rather than assume.
